intro: Ghoul Fangs are gruesome trophies harvested from the undead prowling the blighted groves and cemeteries of Duskwood. In Darkshire, the seer Madame Eva uses them as essential components in crafting defensive talismans for travelers facing the encroaching darkness.

p: The shadowed forest of Duskwood crawls with ravenous undead, from flesh eaters lurking near the graves to rotted corpses roaming the woods. Taking a fang from these monstrous creatures is both grim work and proof of survival against the ravenous dead that threaten Darkshire's borders.

Madame Eva, the resident fortune teller and mystic in Darkshire, sees terrible omens swirling around travelers who dare step through Duskwood. She binds the latent necrotic essence of ghoul fangs alongside skeletal fingers and arachnid venom to enchant the Totem of Infliction, turning the dark forces of the forest into a protective charm against violent assault.
